# The Pediatric Dental Team

> Specialized pediatric dental practice in Philadelphia offering comprehensive dental care, orthodontics, and emergency services for children from infancy through adulthood.

The Pediatric Dental Team is a South Philadelphia-based pediatric dental practice led by experienced dentists who specialize in children's oral health. The practice provides preventive care, orthodontic treatment (braces and Invisalign), sedation dentistry, and emergency services tailored to patients from birth through their teenage years.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric Dentistry
- Philadelphia Dentist
- Children's Dental Care
- Orthodontics & Braces

- South Philadelphia
- Invisalign
